action.objective: Commit g2g3, the sole commit-ready move: address Qh4 pressure and stop the h4-g3/h4-h2 battery threats.
action.rationale: g2g3 is the only commit_ready move. Single-candidate verification at effective depth 4 completed: safety.complete=true, no mating reply, tactical_refutation not_found across checking replies (f8b4). Broad depth-3 search ranked g2g3 top with exact 605, and verification returned exact 601. The move challenges the Black queen on h4, supports the e4 knight's escape, and opens the g2 square as a king route. Risks noted: opponent_captures_after lists Qxe4 and Qxg3 as legal immediate captures, but these are not proven winning for Black; g3 also leaves the h-pawn loosely defended. c1g5 (590) is shallower and unverified, so g2g3 remains preferred. Committing the verified move.
